_description: Semantic version manifest for context-engine. Tag convention: commits that bump composite_version get tagged context-engine-vX.Y.Z.

indexer.name: file-metadata-index
indexer.description: Tag-routable file metadata index over a multi-repo workspace. Produces monolithic JSON + per-repo slices + manifest.

hook.name: manifest-injection
hook.description: UserPromptSubmit hook that injects the routing manifest before every Claude Code prompt.

version_history.summary: Initial public release. Indexer (generate_index.py) + manifest-injection hook. Three-repo example workspace with worked routing traces, pytest suite, and tmux automation guides for Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Grok CLI. Cross-CLI routing verified (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Grok CLI).
